channel.title: DailyBite — Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Jamba: 50% Off Hat Trick Tango Smoothie
item.guid: Jamba-50% Off Hat Trick Tango Smoothie-2026-08-12
item.description: Get 50% off the limited-time Hat Trick Tango smoothie, launched for the FIFA World Cup 2026, via the Jamba app. (Limited time)

item.title: Smoothie King: $5.99 Chicken Flatbread
item.description: Grilled chicken, tomatoes, and cheese on toasted lavash with your choice of chipotle, ranch, or pesto sauce for $5.99 - a promotional price on this filling flatbread sandwich. (Ongoing)

item.title: Shake Shack: $4 Fries + $2 Sodas In-App
item.description: Order Crinkle Cut Fries for $4 and fountain sodas for $2 any time you order through the Shake Shack app or website at participating locations. (Ongoing)

item.title: Wingstop: $24.99 Flavor Lineup Bundle
item.description: Feeds 3-4 people: order classic bone-in wings in up to three flavors (including Sweet Heat Chamoy, Lemon Pepper, Hot Honey Rub, Mango Habanero, Original Hot, or Garlic Parmesan) plus a large fry and large ranch for $24.99 online or in app. (Limited time)

item.title: Chipotle: Free Delivery on $10+ Digital Orders
item.description: Chipotle is waiving its delivery fee (typically $1-$3 per order) on digital orders of $10 or more for a limited time. Order in the app or at chipotle.com - no code needed. Only a saving if you were ordering delivery anyway; service fees still apply. (Limited time)

item.title: Panera: $4.99 Mix & Match Value Menu
item.description: Half- and cup-sized portions of soups, salads, and sandwiches from a 10-item menu for $4.99 each, and every item comes with a free side (baguette, chips, or apple). Pair any two for a full meal under $10 - in cafes and online, no membership needed. (Ongoing)

item.title: Chili’s: 3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.99
item.guid: Chili’s-3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.-2026-08-12
item.description: Chili’s all-day 3 For Me bundles a bottomless drink, an appetizer (chips and salsa or house salad), and a full entree starting at $10.99, with $14.99 and $16.99 tiers - every day at participating locations, no membership needed. (Ongoing)
